meta.scope: TPU / 穿刺針 / 導管 / 光固化 / 熱固化 / PVP-PEG-MPC

papers.title: UV cross-linked polyvinylpyrrolidone electrospun fibres as antibacterial surfaces
papers.venue: Science and Technology of Advanced Materials
papers.purpose: 判斷 PVP 如何透過 UV crosslink 提升耐水洗與表面穩定性
papers.abstract_note: 以 benzophenone(BP) 為交聯劑對 PVP 電紡纖維 UV 光交聯，模量從 4.1 提升至 7.2 GPa，並成功固定溶菌酶達抗菌效果。
papers.value_to_project: BP + PVP UV 交聯機制可直接用於塗層固化設計

papers.title: Protein Repellent, Surface-Attached Hydrogels Through Spray Coating
papers.purpose: 判斷水凝膠親水層如何以 spray coating 固定於表面並抗蛋白吸附
papers.value_to_project: spray coating 固定法的參考

papers.title: Hydrophilic coating comprising a polyelectrolyte
papers.purpose: 親水塗層專利，需看 claims、polyelectrolyte、binder 與交聯架構
papers.abstract_note: polyelectrolyte(ionomer) 提升 dry-out time 與吸水速率。
papers.value_to_project: polyelectrolyte 對 dry-out time 的貢獻機制

papers.title: Surface-attached hydrogel coatings via C,H-insertion crosslinking for biomedical and bioanalytical applications
papers.purpose: C-H insertion / benzophenone 類固定化，對 TPU 低反應表面非常關鍵
papers.value_to_project: C-H insertion 機制對 TPU 低反應表面固定最關鍵

papers.title: Hydrophilic coating
papers.purpose: 親水塗層專利，需比對 coating composition、crosslinking、溶劑與 substrate claims
papers.abstract_note: Pebax 7233 導管以 Harland PCX coater 塗覆；含 Norrish I (Irgacure 2959) + Norrish II (benzophenone)。
papers.value_to_project: 雙光起始劑系統(Type I + Type II)配方參考

papers.title: Preparation of lubricant and antifouling medical coating on thermoplastic polyurethane
papers.purpose: 直接對 TPU medical coating，若能取得全文對配方最有價值
papers.value_to_project: 直接針對 TPU medical coating

papers.title: Medical Coating on Thermoplastic Polyurethane by Sequential Deposition of Photo-crosslinkable and Bio-inspired Zwitterionic Phosphocholine Copolymers
papers.purpose: TPU + photo-crosslinkable + zwitterionic phosphocholine，與本案 Plan B 高度相關
papers.value_to_project: TPU + photo-crosslinkable MPC，Plan B 高性能配方

papers.title: Deposition of Photoactive Layer on Thermoplastic Polyurethane Tubes for Photo-grafting poly(2-methacryloyloxyethyl phosphorylcholine)
papers.authors: Tran Thi Diem Trang et al.
papers.purpose: TPU tube + photoactive layer + MPC photografting，對導管親水塗層附著最直接
papers.value_to_project: TPU tube photoactive layer，對導管附著最直接

papers.title: Functional Diblock Copolymer Containing Zwitterionic Phosphocholine and Clickable Benzophenone for Medical Coating on Thermoplastic Polyurethane Catheter
papers.purpose: benzophenone + MPC diblock copolymer，直接對應 photoactive primer / anchor
papers.value_to_project: benzophenone + MPC diblock，photoactive primer / anchor 直接對應

papers.title: Photoreactive Polymers Bearing a Zwitterionic Phosphorylcholine Group for Surface Modification of Biomaterials
papers.purpose: photoreactive MPC polymer，支撐抗蛋白/抗細菌沾附與光固定化
papers.abstract_note: 合成含 benzophenone(MHPBP) 與 MPC 的共聚物(PMH)，UV 照射後 BP 以 C-H 抽氫共價固定於基材；最大吸收 254/289 nm；高親水、抗蛋白吸附。
papers.value_to_project: 核心機制：BP anchor + MPC 雙功能設計是 Plan B 理論基礎

papers.title: Water-Soluble Photoinitiators in Biomedical Applications
papers.purpose: 光起始劑選型核心文獻，需抓水溶性、低毒性、光源匹配、黃變與殘留風險
papers.abstract_note: 綜述生醫用水溶性光起始劑分類與機制；強調高水溶性、低細胞毒性、可見光相容性。Type I 代表 Irgacure 2959；Type II 代表 benzophenone。
papers.value_to_project: I2959 為 UV 配方首選光起始劑；BP 適用 primer photografting

papers.title: Photooxidation of poly(N-vinylpyrrolidone) (PVP) in the solid state and in aqueous solution
papers.purpose: PVP UV 劑量與光氧化/降解風險，避免只追求高 UV dose
papers.abstract_note: UV 照射導致 PVP 主鏈氧化裂解，固態與水溶液皆會發生；過高 UV dose 使分子量下降、親水性劣化。
papers.value_to_project: UV 劑量不是越高越好，需建立 dose-lubricity 曲線

papers.title: Coating composition for a urinary catheter
papers.purpose: 導尿管 coating composition 專利，需看 hydrophilic polymer、supporting polymer、crosslinker 與 claims
papers.abstract_note: 雙層塗層：內層 polyether primer (Norrish I, Irgacure 2959)，外層 PVP + polyelectrolyte (Norrish II, benzophenone)；總厚度 2-10 μm 最佳；摩擦力 ≤20g。
papers.value_to_project: 完整雙層 UV 塗層配方與 Harland FTS 測試規格基準

papers.title: Photoinitiating behavior of benzophenone derivatives covalently bonded tertiary amine group for UV-curing acrylate systems
papers.purpose: benzophenone derivative / tertiary amine 對 UV acrylate 固化與抽氫機制有參考價值
papers.value_to_project: BP + tertiary amine 抽氫機制參考

papers.title: Shrinkage of UV oligomers and monomers
papers.purpose: UV 固化收縮會影響附著、裂紋與 coating 應力，對耐磨耗有間接影響
papers.value_to_project: UV 收縮應力對附著與裂紋的間接影響

papers.title: Preparation and evaluation of a UV-curing hydrophilic semi-IPN coating for medical guidewires
papers.authors: Ding, Zhao, Jiang, Jian, Song, Wang
papers.venue: Journal of Coatings Technology and Research
papers.purpose: TPU 基材 UV semi-IPN 配方最直接參考
papers.abstract_note: PUA 先固化為 transition layer 增強附著，PVP + PEGDA 滲入並 UV 固化形成 semi-IPN；用於 TPU 鞘覆 nitinol 導線。
papers.value_to_project: 最直接的 TPU + UV semi-IPN 配方框架；PUA primer 思路可轉用

papers.title: A low-friction and high-stability hydrophilic PVP/PEG coated TPU for interventional catheter applications
papers.purpose: PDA 中間層 + PVP/PEG UV 固化的分子量優化參考
papers.abstract_note: PDA 弱鹼自聚沉積於 TPU，作黏著中間層進行 PVP/PEG UV 固化；WCA 91.3°→28.3°；摩擦係數從 0.4 降低；I2959 光起始劑；PVP K30/K90、PEG 400/4000/20000。
papers.value_to_project: PDA 中間層替代 BP primer 的可行方案；分子量優化數據

papers.title: Preparation and performance optimization of PVP/PVA coatings with high adhesion and high hydrophilicity for coronary guidewires
papers.purpose: 最新正交優化數據；PVA 加入 PVP 體系的附著提升機制
papers.abstract_note: 因冠狀動脈導線塗層剝落不良事件，優化 PVA/PVP 塗層；以 TPU 為基材，PDA 沉積 + UV 固化；正交實驗優化 PVA/PVP/PEGDA 與光起始劑比例。
papers.value_to_project: 最新(2025)正交優化；PVA+PVP 附著提升機制

papers.title: Influence of a Biocompatible Hydrophilic Needle Surface Coating on a Puncture Biopsy Process for Biomedical Applications
papers.purpose: 唯一直接對穿刺針親水塗層的開放全文；FEM 穿刺力分析
papers.abstract_note: 建立簡化 FEM 穿刺模型並以體外實驗驗證；比較有/無親水超潤滑塗層的穿刺力差異；降低針與生物軟組織摩擦力。
papers.value_to_project: 唯一直接對穿刺針的開放全文；FEM 方法論可用於穿刺力評估

papers.title: Lubricious echogenic coatings (Patent WO2007089761A2)
papers.purpose: 活檢針親水潤滑 + 回聲雙功能塗層；針型與塗層 claims
papers.abstract_note: 同時提供親水潤滑與超音波回聲雙功能；適用 biopsy needle/trocar/catheter；先塗親水高分子層再覆回聲結構；針型含骨髓/乳腺/軟組織活檢針(16G/18G)。
papers.value_to_project: 活檢針親水塗層專利；claims 結構與 durability 要求

papers.title: UV cure topcoatings for medical devices (Patent US12037560B2)
papers.purpose: 最新 benzophenone 衍生物 UV topcoat；迴避設計參考
papers.abstract_note: 4-Methacryloxy-2-hydroxy benzophenone(MHB) 與 HEAA 及 Acrylic Acid 共聚成親水光活性高分子；lubricity <25 gf、durability <50 gf (Harland FTS pinch test)；UV 固化。
papers.value_to_project: 最新 UV topcoat 專利(2024)；BP 衍生物 + 極性 acrylate 路徑，claims 可作迴避設計參考
